text: The last piece of this phase is proving where a number actually comes from. We picked one real tile on the executive dashboard: Q3 Active Customer Revenue.
Using Purview's automated lineage, built from scanning Fabric and Power BI metadata, we traced it backward hop by hop -- no hand-drawn diagram required.

From the dashboard, back through the semantic model measure, the Fabric lakehouse table, and the dataflow that joins Oracle's Active Customer status to Snowflake's revenue -- down to both real source systems.
Every hop showed up in the lineage graph with nothing missing, and we independently reran the same aggregation directly against the lakehouse to check it.
It matched exactly. The number on the VP of Finance's screen is traceable, verified, and documented end to end.
